Privacy Policy

Effective October 22, 2026.

This policy describes information collected through the John Crawford Company website and how to contact us about it.

Information you provide

The forms displayed on this preview do not accept submissions or file uploads. If you email us, we receive the contact information, project details and any photos or attachments you choose to send.

How your information is used

We use inquiry information to respond, discuss your project and provide the help you request. Our website providers also process information to operate and protect the website.

Website providers

This website is hosted through Netlify and, for the preview, ChatGPT Sites. Hosting providers may process technical information, such as IP addresses, browser details and request logs, to deliver and secure the website.

Embedded services and tracking

This website includes a Google Maps embed. Loading that map may allow Google to receive device and visit information and use its own cookies or similar technologies. Social profile links take you to separate services when you open them. Those providers' privacy practices apply to their services. See Google's Privacy Policy (opens in a new tab).

We have not installed advertising pixels or audience-tracking analytics on this website. The website does not change its behavior in response to browser Do Not Track signals. Embedded third-party services may follow their own tracking practices.

Your inquiry and privacy requests

To ask about access, correction or deletion of information you provided directly to us, email john@johncrawford.com or call (818) 884-5464. We may need to verify your request and retain records required for an ongoing project or by law.

You can also write to John Crawford Company, 22311 Ventura Blvd #101, Woodland Hills, CA 91364.

Policy updates

We will post changes on this page and update the effective date when this policy changes.
